name: Thiều Chửu, Hán Việt tự điển (digitized by catusf/tudien)
gives: Hán Việt readings per character (the reading field only; the definitions are not used)
credit: Thiều Chửu, Hán Việt tự điển (1942); digital edition proofread by Đặng Thế Kiệt, Lê Văn Đặng, Nguyễn Hữu Vinh; file by Phan Cát Tú (catusf/tudien, CC0)
notes: The primary Hán Việt source (owner's decision, 2026-11-10): Unihan kVietnamese often gives Nôm readings (细 tới, 搬 bưng) and lacks common characters. Thiều Chửu's text (1942; the author died 1954) is public domain in Vietnam; the file is CC0 per its repo. The proofreaders' credit comes from a third party (bat-nha-key's NGUON-DU-LIEU.md), not from the repo. Simplified headwords in the file appear to be generated from the traditional entries. Readings use the older tone placement (thụy, đọa).
